title: 秒速の残響、月蝕の呼吸
author: 茜 ランナー

en.title: Echoes of a Second, Breath of the Lunar Eclipse
en.premise: Unable to maintain a 3:15 pace, 'I' lost the meaning of running and fled to a desolate coastal town. There stood an old lighthouse, once tended by a keeper, and a long shoreline perfect for a lonely runner. On a night when a lunar eclipse plunges the world into darkness, deprived of sight, 'I' attempt a sprint beyond all limits, relying solely on the sound of my own heartbeat and breath. This is a story of rebirth, as a body once enslaved by numbers rediscovers the rhythm of life.

zh.title: 秒速的残响，月蚀的呼吸
zh.premise: 无法再跑出3分15秒配速的“我”，失去了奔跑的意义，逃到了海岸边一座荒废的小镇。那里有一座据说曾有灯塔看守人的古老灯塔，以及一条为孤独跑者准备的长长海岸线。在月食让世界陷入黑暗之夜，失去视觉的“我”仅凭心跳与呼吸之声，尝试一次超越极限的疾走。这是一个关于身体从被数值支配，重新找回生命律动的重生故事。

雫が差し出した一冊の本に答えを見出す
誰の助言も無視し、衝動的に夜の海へ走る
